headline: SEA @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 4.64 at WSN 4.09, with a projected total of 8.73. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward WSN: SEA moved -0.39 runs while WSN moved +1.12, changing the projected margin by -1.51 runs. The projected total climbed +0.73, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Luis Castillo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Cole Young, Josh Naylor, Randy Arozarena, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Andrés Chaparro, Luke Raley because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
